title: Lovelace Academy - Free video course "Plutus Experience" - Transcription and subtitling to Portuguese

ms.promise:
The transcription and translation process will be the following for every video that we'll provide Portuguese subtitle:
・An AI will generate the SRT file (transcription and translation done automatically);
・The SRT file will be uploaded to the YouTube studio tool;
・Using the YouTube studio tool, the human translator will review the SRT and adjust it as needed to ensure a high quality subtitle;
・Publish the Portuguese subtitle using the YouTube studio tool, so anyone watching the video can select to use Portuguese subtitle.

For this first milestone, we'll deliver the Portuguese subtitle option for the first 3 modules of the course:
・Module 1: 3 videos with a "Portuguese" subtitle option: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Vw5uCnR6Vzs&list=PLHJ1yaDcSSadb0aO4aBeq3xaoqzXOG9fB
・Module 2: 3 videos with a "Portuguese" subtitle option: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W1G67vyG4Mc&list=PLHJ1yaDcSSafWreBFrVKB9LP40fNSbwkF
・Module 3: 7 videos with a "Portuguese" subtitle option: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tPxCSZTraaE&list=PLHJ1yaDcSSacnFsxlI4RuWmh_qY8MpyJo

ms.criteria:
As stated in the first milestone, the intended outcome is a high quality and precise Portuguese subtitles to the specific videos targeted by this milestone.
Our process already has built-in quality control (the human translator). This was done to ensure that the subtitles were of high quality, unlike what is achieved using AI alone.
The objective will be considered achieved if modules 9, 10, 11 and 12 contain the option of accurate Portuguese subtitles, without errors and with good synchronization with the video.
